description: One programme declaration (the supervision directory row; written via POST /api/v1/programmes, upsert). Cadence, band, escalation, and venue are declarations, never evaluator constants. rule_text and cadence_minutes are contract-sourced: contracts.sync refreshes them from the goal record at contract_path — the goal record owns those fields (contract 11) and this row is their directory projection, never a duplicate source.
title: Programme declaration (contract 01, §9.1)
